title: REST API Blocked or Broken
description: Fix /wp-json/ errors breaking the block editor, headless setups, Application Passwords, and third-party integrations.

steps.title: Test REST API Endpoint
steps.instructions: Visit https://yoursite.com/wp-json/ in browser or curl. Note HTTP status (404, 403, 500) and error message. Test /wp-json/wp/v2/posts as well.

steps.title: Flush Permalinks and Rewrite Rules
steps.instructions: Broken rewrites cause REST 404s. Save Settings → Permalinks. Verify .htaccess or nginx config passes requests to index.php.

steps.title: Check Security Plugin REST Restrictions
steps.instructions: Wordfence, iThemes, and Disable REST API plugins can block endpoints. Whitelist REST for authenticated users or disable overly aggressive rules.

steps.title: Review Server and CDN Rules
steps.instructions: WAF, mod_security, or Cloudflare may block /wp-json/ requests. Add allow rule for REST paths. Check for rate limiting on API routes.

steps.title: Fix SSL and Redirect Issues on REST
steps.instructions: REST calls over http on an https-only site may redirect-loop or fail. Ensure siteurl uses https and REST URL matches.

steps.title: Isolate Plugin Filtering rest_authentication_errors
steps.instructions: Plugins hooking rest_authentication_errors or rest_pre_dispatch can break all API access. Disable suspects and retest.

steps.title: Configure CORS for Headless (If Applicable)
steps.instructions: Headless front ends need correct CORS headers. Add allowed origins via plugin or server config. Test preflight OPTIONS requests.

steps.title: Verify Block Editor and Integrations
steps.instructions: Confirm block editor loads, Application Password auth works, and any headless/mobile integrations connect. Check Site Health REST test passes.
